test_title: PYST 72: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He did nothing **but to complain** all day.
solution:
The correct answer is '**3**' i.e. but complain.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "did nothing but" is followed by the base form of the verb without "to." This is a grammatical rule for constructing sentences with "did nothing but."
 
• Option 3, "but complain," uses the correct base form of the verb "complain" after "did
